# Bloomberg

> Bloomberg's customer support and account management portal providing billing, invoicing, and professional service access.

Bloomberg offers comprehensive account management tools for Bloomberg Professional subscribers. The portal enables users to access billing information, manage invoices, and view account reports through a centralized customer portal.

## Key Topics

- Bloomberg Professional
- Account Billing
- Invoice Access
- Billing Portal
- Account Reports
- Customer Portal
- Accounts Receivable
- Bloomberg SID

## Account & Billing Management

- [Account Billing](https://service.bloomberg.com/portal/bobis/index): Bloomberg Professional account billing portal for invoice access and account reports
